entry.title: Electrical Networks and Random Walks
entry.content: Hi, this material was prepared for a lecture to the participants of STEMS 2026, an annual training camp conducted by CMI students for outstanding high school and college students.
entry.summary: Today I will mainly talk about how to connect the notion of electrical networks and random walks. It gives a new perspective on an important and a very interesting subject in Probability and Statistics. I also solve an olympiad problem with it.
